name: goods
summary: People sell everyday things, new or used.
description: Things are handed over and paid in person, or shipped when the price is one either side could lose; not motor vehicles or homes.

description.description: The item, in the writer's words, and anything to know about it.

price.description: The price of the item, without shipping; in a request, the most the buyer would pay.

category.description: What kind of thing it is. Accessories are bags, jewellery and the like; home is things for the home, such as kitchenware, but not furniture or appliances; music is instruments and records; games are board games and video games; baby is prams, cots and the like, not clothes or shoes; sports is gear for a sport; bikes include children's bikes.

condition.description: The item's state: new is never used, like new is used with no sign of it, good shows light wear, fair shows clear wear, and for parts does not work; in a request, the worst the buyer would take.

brand.description: The brand, and the model if known, such as Levi's 501 or iPhone 13 128 GB.

wearer.description: Who it is made for, as the person says: children include babies; for both women and men, both.

size.description: The letter size on the label, such as m.

waist.description: The waist in inches, as the label of trousers or jeans prints it after W, such as w32.

leg.description: The leg length in inches, as the label of trousers or jeans prints it after L, such as l34.

age.description: The age the label of children's clothes prints, in months or years, such as 4-5y for 4 to 5 years.

footLength.description: The foot length the shoe fits, in centimetres, as its label prints it after CM, such as 26.5; never converted from another size.

labelSize.description: The size as the person gives it, with its system where they name one, such as EU 38, UK 10 or 42; only where they give none of size, waist, leg, age or footLength.

handover.description: How it is handed over: in person, shipped, or both; in a request, the ways the buyer would take it.

place.description: Where the item is; in a request, where the buyer is.

asDescribed.description: Whether the item was as the listing said.
